jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era.

Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects.

Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.

We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt).

 

About the Team

The Developer Experience team at Diagrid is obsessed with making distributed applications radically simpler and more reliable for developers worldwide. We steward the wildly popular open-source Dapr project (CNCF) while driving adoption of Diagrid’s commercial platform (Diagrid Catalyst) that brings production-grade reliability and security for AI agents.

Our mission is to make AI agents reliable and secure for the Dapr and Diagrid community. We create inspiring demos, technical content, events, and tools that turn developers into advocates and help them ship faster, more resilient systems.

 

About the Role

As a Developer Relations Engineer based in the San Francisco Bay Area, you will be the public face and community heartbeat of Dapr and Diagrid. You’ll own community growth, content creation, and developer engagement end-to-end. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who loves coding in public, building communities, and turning complex distributed systems + AI agent concepts into approachable, delightful experiences.

You will report work closely with Engineering, Product, Marketing, Sales, and the broader open-source maintainer team.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Grow the Dapr OSS Community: Drive contributor growth, engagement, and adoption metrics across GitHub, Discord, and other channels.

  • Moderate & Nurture the Ecosystem: Actively moderate the Dapr Discord (and future community platforms), answer technical questions, recognize contributors, and foster a welcoming, high-signal environment.

  • Create Compelling Content: Write high-quality blog posts for the Dapr blog and Diagrid Catalyst, produce tutorials, architectural guides, and sample applications showcasing Dapr + AI agents, workflows, state management, service invocation, and more.

  • Lead Webinars & Live Sessions: Proactively plan and deliver technical webinars, workshops, and live demos on a regular cadence.

  • Manage YouTube & Video Presence: Own the Dapr/Diagrid YouTube channel — script, record, edit, and publish videos, demos, and recordings of community events.

  • Coordinate Events & Meetups: Help organize and host Dapr Meetups, Dapr Days, conference talks, and community events in the Bay Area and globally (with travel as needed).

  • Build Diagrid Demos & Tools: Create sample applications, starters, and reference architectures that demonstrate best practices for Dapr in production and AI agent use cases.

  • Gather Feedback & Influence Product: Act as the voice of the developer community — surface friction points, feature requests, and success stories to Engineering and Product teams.

  • Represent Diagrid publicly: Speak at conferences, participate in podcasts, engage on social media (X, LinkedIn, etc.), and be a trusted advocate for Dapr and Diagrid.

 

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have prior Developer Relations, Developer Advocate, or Community Manager experience.

  • Have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong hands-on knowledge of distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, Kubernetes, or microservices.

  • Are deeply familiar with Dapr (or similar projects like Temporal, Camunda, Orkes, etc.) and excited about its future in the AI agent era.

  • Love creating content and have a track record of blogs, videos, talks, or open-source contributions that gained traction.

  • Excel at community building — you’ve moderated Discords/Slack, grown OSS projects, or run successful meetup groups.

  • Are a strong communicator who can explain complex topics (stateful workflows, actor models, sidecar architecture, LLM orchestration) clearly and enthusiastically.

  • Enjoy shipping code publicly and building demos with Python, Go, TypeScript, or .NET.

  • Thrive in a fast-moving startup environment with high ownership and evolving priorities.

  • Are based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

 

Nice-to-Haves

  • Speaking experience at conferences (KubeCon, Microsoft Build, etc.).

  • Experience with AI agents, LangChain/LlamaIndex, or workflow orchestration.

  • Existing relationships in the cloud-native or AI developer communities.

Diagrid Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Company equity

  • Remote first & flexible work environment

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Comprehensive healthcare for you and your dependents

  • Choice of hardware

  • $1000 for home office setup

  • Monthly WFH stipend

  • Team events & gatherings

  • Chance to collaborate with industry-leading figures 

Diagrid, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era.

Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects.

Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.

We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt).

 

About the Team:

We are looking for Enterprise Account Executives to help accelerate our go-to-market efforts at Diagrid. The team consist of talented and passionate professionals with an entrepreneurial spirit to hunt, farm and grow the business.

 

Diagrid builds solutions for developers, platform engineers and security teams. Dapr (dapr.io) is an important foundation to the Diagrid solution providing customers with APIs that abstract away the complexity of common challenges when building distributed applications so they can focus on business value and keep code lean and portable. Diagrid Catalyst is our SaaS and BYOC product helping customers make AI agents reliable and secure.

 

This role is remote but the hires must be located in: (1) SF / Bay Area; (2) New York; and/or (3) London, UK.

 

About the Role:

We’re looking to expand our sales team by hiring an Enterprise Account Executive who has experience and is passionate about selling technical solutions to engineering and security teams.

 

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth through the acquisition of new enterprise clients, startups and digital natives. In addition, you will be on-point for expanding existing relationships with current customers.

 

As an early Enterprise Account Executive for Diagrid, you will have the opportunity to influence the strategy of our go-to-market team and represent the ‘voice of the customer’ to influence the direction of our product.

 

You’ll be a brand ambassador with customers and with teammates alike. You will have many opportunities for cross-functional collaboration with partners in marketing, customer success, and product. We’re looking for an experienced, self-starter who can hit the ground running, is passionate about talking to customers, and can wear multiple hats in these early days of unlocking business.

 

Responsibilities:

  • New Customer Acquisition: Meet and exceed revenue targets, with a focus on acquiring new customers within the developer community. Proactively source new leads and new business opportunities to ensure a robust pipeline. Evangelize Diagrid’s products to new customers.

  • Customer Relationship Management:

    • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers. Act as the main point of contact for client inquiries and ensure customer satisfaction.

    • Present the value of Diagrid software to senior executives mainly across technical functions.

    • Reach out to new trials/users within customers to expand use cases and drive more revenue.

    • Ensure healthy customer retention and expansion through consultative partnerships.

  • Market Analysis: Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive insights. Use this information to inform sales strategies and positioning in the market. Stay abreast of industry trends and competitor activities to inform strategic decision-making.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with the customer success, product, and marketing teams to align sales efforts with overall company objectives. Provide valuable insights from customer interactions to shape product development and marketing strategies. Collect and share product feedback to our internal teams.

  • Pipeline Management: Build the reports to help define the sales pipeline. Manage and track sales pipeline and forecast accurately in Hubspot. Utilize Hubspot to maintain up-to-date information on leads, opportunities, and customer interactions.

  • Sales Presentations: Deliver compelling presentations and product demonstrations to potential clients, showcasing the value proposition of Diagrid's solutions. Be an exemplary ambassador for Diagrid, both internally and externally.

  • Feedback Loop: Act as a bridge between customers and the internal teams, providing feedback on customer needs, pain points, and industry trends. Collect and share product feedback to our internal teams.

 

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of technology sales experience with a preference for technical SaaS products and/or infrastructure.

  • 5-10+ years of quota-carrying sales closing experience with a track record of over-performance.

  • Experience on a fast-growing sales team with a preference for startup and product-led companies.

  • Strong communicator, both verbal and written, with great poise and concise articulation.

  • Excellent negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, the ability and the desire to find solutions and build processes where none previously exists.

  • On top of being a product expert of Diagrid, you thrive as an industry expert and thought leader. You create ‘Ah ha!’ moments for customers, speaking directly to their challenges and coming up with viable solutions.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous, diverse, and highly collaborative team environment.

  • You obsess over providing a top-tier experience for your customers

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

 

Diagrid Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Company equity

  • Remote first & flexible work environment

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Comprehensive healthcare for you and your dependents

  • Choice of hardware

  • $1000 for home office setup

  • Monthly WFH stipend

  • Team events & gatherings

  • Chance to collaborate with industry-leading figures 

Diagrid, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

About Diagrid

At Diagrid, we're building the infrastructure that helps developers build, deploy, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable applications.

Built on the foundation of Dapr, the CNCF-graduated open-source project, Diagrid is helping engineering teams simplify the complexity of distributed systems. As AI transforms how software is built and operated, we're extending that mission to help developers take AI agents from experimentation to production with confidence.

We're a globally distributed team of engineers and builders who care deeply about solving complex technical problems, contributing to open source, and creating products developers love.

About the Role

We're looking for a talented Fullstack Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript experience to join our growing AI & DevEx team, led by Casper Nielsen.

You'll help build the next generation of Diagrid's AI infrastructure and developer tools, working across backend services, APIs, and user-facing applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building products end-to-end, solving complex technical challenges, and working in a fast-moving startup environment.

You'll work closely with engineering and product leadership to turn ideas into production-ready capabilities, with a focus on performance, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Build end-to-end product features: Design, develop, and maintain fullstack applications using TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frontend frameworks.

  • Develop scalable backend services: Build APIs, integrations, and services that power Diagrid's AI infrastructure and developer-facing products.

  • Work on AI infrastructure: Help develop the tools and services that enable developers to build, deploy, manage, and operate AI agents reliably in production.

  • Own features from concept to production: Participate in technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvements.

  • Create great developer experiences: Build intuitive interfaces, APIs, and workflows that make complex distributed systems easier to use.

  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with AI, platform, product, and engineering teams to solve technical challenges and deliver customer value.

  • Champion engineering quality: Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, contribute to architectural decisions, and continuously improve engineering practices.

  • Solve challenging technical problems: Work on distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, integrations, and the reliability challenges that come with production AI applications.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong professional experience developing production applications with TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Experience building modern web applications using React or a similar frontend framework.

  • Solid understanding of backend architecture, REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and service integrations.

  • Experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar technologies.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native development, containerization, and modern deployment practices.

  • Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, performance, security, and maintainability.

  • Ability to independently own technical projects and deliver high-quality solutions.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working in an environment where requirements evolve.

  • Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams.

  • A product mindset and genuine interest in understanding the problems developers and customers are trying to solve.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI-powered applications, AI agents, or LLM integrations.

  • Familiarity with AI frameworks, orchestration tools, or agent development patterns.

  • Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or microservices.

  • Knowledge of Dapr, Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with real-time systems, messaging, or asynchronous workflows.

  • Contributions to open-source projects or experience working with developer-focused products.

  • Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth technology startup.

Working Hours

Diagrid's team works across Europe and North America.

Our India team’s day typically starts around 12:00 PM IST, with afternoons overlapping Europe and evenings overlapping the US. You’ll need to be available for a core US overlap window of 8:30 PM to 12:00 AM IST; outside that, you can structure your day flexibly.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting

Build at the intersection of AI and distributed systems. Work on real engineering challenges involved in making AI agents reliable, secure, and production-ready.

Make a meaningful impact. Join a growing engineering team where your ideas, technical decisions, and contributions directly influence the products we build.

Own what you build. Take responsibility for features end-to-end, from initial design through production and continuous improvement.

Work with experienced engineers. Collaborate with a globally distributed team building infrastructure for the next generation of software.

Help shape what's next. Be part of an ambitious company working at the forefront of cloud-native and AI application development.

Diagrid Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Company equity

  • Remote first & flexible work environment

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Comprehensive healthcare for you and your dependents

  • Choice of hardware

  • $1000 for home office setup

  • Monthly WFH stipend

  • Team events & gatherings

  • Chance to collaborate with industry-leading figures

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era.

Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects.

Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.

We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt).

About Dapr

Dapr (Distributed Application Runtime) is a graduated CNCF project that helps developers build distributed, cloud-native applications. It gives them APIs for the hard parts: durable workflows, actors, service invocation, state, pub/sub, scheduled jobs and secure service-to-service communication. Dapr runs in production at companies such as Zeiss, IBM, NASA, Bosch and Lufthansa.

 

About the role

You join Diagrid's Runtime team, the engineers who build Dapr and run it inside Diagrid Catalyst. Your work lands in public, in the Dapr open source project, and in the product our customers run in production.

You will design and ship features in the Dapr runtime, review code from the community and from your team, and help keep releases stable. Much of the current work is in durable execution (Dapr Workflows, actors and the scheduler), where correctness under failure matters more than speed.

We build with AI every day. We look for engineers who use AI to go further and who check what it produces: you read the diff, you test the failure path, and you own the result, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft. In an open source project, reviewing and verifying code matters as much as writing it.

You are a full member of the team: the same ownership, the same voice in design, and the same chance to grow into a Dapr maintainer as everyone else.

 

Working hours

Diagrid's team works across Europe and North America.

Our India team’s day typically starts around 12:00 PM IST, with afternoons overlapping Europe and evenings overlapping the US. You’ll need to be available for a core US overlap window of 8:30 PM to 12:00 AM IST; outside that, you can structure your day flexibly.

 

What you will do

  • Design and build features in the Dapr runtime, from proposal to release.

  • Review pull requests from the community and from your team. Hold the bar on correctness, tests and API design.

  • Find and fix bugs in distributed code: race conditions, retries, partial failures, and state that must survive a crash.

  • Write proposals and design docs in public, and respond to review on them.

  • Take part in Dapr releases: release candidates, patch releases and security fixes.

  • Help users and contributors on GitHub and Discord, and mentor new contributors.

 

What we look for

  • 5+ years of professional Go, with production code you can explain line by line.

  • Experience designing and running distributed systems. You know how they fail, and you design for it.

  • 2+ years with Kubernetes and containers.

  • A strong computer science base: concurrency, networking and data consistency.

  • Daily, practical use of AI coding tools, and the judgment to check their output before you ship it.

  • Clear written English. Most of our work happens in GitHub issues, pull requests and design docs, read by people across many companies and time zones.

Leading in India

You’ll be our first engineer in India, and you’ll help build the team that follows. Engineers who join in India will report to technical managers on their own teams, with a dotted line to you. Their managers own their day-to-day work and performance; you’re their local lead and point of contact.

  • Help hire the India team: shape the hiring process, interview candidates and help us find the right people.

  • Onboard new engineers and help them become productive in Dapr, our codebase and how we work.

  • Be the go-to person in India for questions, feedback and support, and raise issues to their managers when needed.

  • Build a strong engineering culture in India that matches how we work across Diagrid: ownership, quality and working in the open.

  • Work with leadership on India-specific topics such as hiring plans, working hours and team setup.

  • Represent Diagrid in the local engineering and open source community, through meetups, conferences and contributor outreach.

This role stays hands-on. Most of your time goes to engineering work on the runtime, and the leadership side grows as the team does.

 

Bonus

  • Merged contributions to open source Go projects, especially CNCF projects.

  • Experience as a maintainer of an open source project.

  • Experience with Dapr, or with workflow and durable execution engines (Temporal, Azure Durable Functions, AWS Step Functions).

  • gRPC and Protocol Buffers.

  • One of the other languages Dapr has SDKs for: Java, Python, JavaScript, .NET or Rust.

We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era.



Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects.



Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr https://dapr.io/ and KEDA https://keda.sh/ open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.



We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt).

About Dapr

Dapr https://dapr.io/ (Distributed Application Runtime) is a graduated CNCF project that helps developers build distributed, cloud-native applications. Dapr runs in production at companies such as Zeiss, IBM, NASA, Bosch and Lufthansa.
